name.en-US: On the Sacrifice of Unleavened and Leavened Bread
name.pt-BR: Sobre o sacrifício do pão ázimo e fermentado

description.la: Epistola Anselmi ad Valerannum Naumburgensem episcopum de sacrificio azymi et fermentati, de diversitate rituum Latinorum et Graecorum. Textus ex editione Migne (Patrologia Latina 158, 1853).
description.en-US: Anselm’s letter to Bishop Waleran of Naumburg on the Eucharist celebrated in unleavened bread by the Latins and in leavened bread by the Greeks. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 158, 1853), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: A carta de Anselmo ao bispo Valerano de Naumburgo sobre a Eucaristia celebrada em pão ázimo pelos latinos e em pão fermentado pelos gregos.

sources.edition: S. Anselmi Cantuariensis archiepiscopi opera omnia, ed. J.-P. Migne, Patrologia Latina 158 (Paris 1853), the Gerberon text; TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text 10607, from the Open Greek and Latin machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: The complete text with its chapter divisions and PL chapter summaries. PL page breaks, the column numbers and the apparatus of alternative chapter numbers (al.) are dropped; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Anselm died in 1109; Migne’s 1853 printing is public domain everywhere.
